deterministic_data.verification: Final Workbench assembly is 14/14 ready with zero errors and warnings, including the Factory canonical validator; the Factory slicer probe cuts 30 of 30 modules with no seam refusal and every changed data address reaching a module. Contract-only DTO identities and every tagged sum type are closed in 60_model_closure_contract_types.json.

modules.summary: Domain models, contract-only DTOs, opaque runtime carriers and tagged sum types are structurally closed; the CompositionView item uses a non-callable discriminator distinct from flow_registry.composition_view. AuthenticationFailureDelayRule is the contract-only row model of the data_provider back-off table.

Deterministic constant module (data_provider_backend/v1), now the one home of every policy value generated code reads: 32 constants of the first review plus the 17 release ceilings of A26/M48 (positive_integer, equal to the M48 list) and the ordered A03 disclosure classes. No rules or config address repeats a value; source_refs of the closure name the deciding State 2 decisions. SERVICE_INVOCATION_PURPOSE gives service_transport the third A23/A29 purpose as a scalar.

The module is the sole authority for wall and elapsed time. system_clock_backend/v3 emits exactly now and monotonic_ns under time_source_policy/v1; monotonic_ns is intentionally internal and injected into elapsed-time consumers.
All 9 owned contracts are covered by 9 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation.

The protected JSON configuration contract, exact key schema and credential-purpose policy close host configuration; load_installation is intentionally internal. Configuration key names, format version, file-mode bound and the purpose vocabulary arrive as imported data_provider constants, and release_ceilings builds the ReleaseCeilings record field by field from the seventeen imported RELEASE_CEILING_* constants with the A26 consistency checks stated; every function names keys only through imported constants.

One SQLite operational store behind the typed unit-of-work port; open_store is the only schema owner and names the thirty-two = config.persistence.<table>_table_name leaves that create_operational_store_schema creates, the layout names and continuity states are imported constants, and the emitted repository is the only reader of the persistence IR.

Owner-only decisions, delegation issuance and revocation, the fixed A27 throttle (imported constants and back-off table) and the two channel purposes are closed; resolve_actor bounds the presented text by the bounded_text_bytes_max field of the ReleaseCeilings it reads through installation.release_ceilings, so the ceiling has a source instead of an undereferenced address.
Typed unit-of-work operations close vocabulary identity, duplicate detection, issue, retirement and lookup behavior.

Slot and contract-version lifecycle, port validation against accepted term revisions and implementation records are closed; validate_contract_ports bounds a byte_stream port's size_ceiling_bytes by the run_spool_file_bytes_max field of the ReleaseCeilings read through installation.release_ceilings.

Content-identified trial cases over exact contract versions, captured cases from trace evidence and active-corpus snapshots are closed; add_trial_case judges a value against the stored_value_bytes_max field of the ReleaseCeilings read through installation.release_ceilings and a file against its port, and the personal-data class is an imported constant.

A34 and rules.sandbox_runtime close execution to Linux bubblewrap, external rlimits, bounded exchange and proven cleanup. The A34 profile identifier is no longer a generator input; the note spells the mechanism itself.
Exact trial execution, persisted evidence and sandbox invocation leave no materially different admission behavior.
All 4 owned contracts are covered by 4 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation.

A31, rules.platform_manifest_contract and content-addressed evidence now fix exact record paths/bytes, legacy field shapes, same-path ancestor lookup, opaque idempotency text and installation-owned credentials; all 3 contracts and notes are deterministic and fail closed. The A31 contract arrives as the imported PLATFORM_MANIFEST_CONTRACT mapping and the note names the five entries it reads.
Typed lifecycle events, manifest revalidation and unit-of-work access close binding acceptance, drift, retirement and lookup.
All 1 owned contracts are covered by 1 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation.
Typed unit-of-work operations close all flow/version/proof/activation record access and lifecycle behavior.
Typed atomic approval/grant/delegation operations and exact attempt identity close authority behavior.

HTTP-only exactly-once transport with fail-closed channels, credential resolution at send time and monotonic local timing is closed; send_request caps every httpx timeout by the transport_timeout_ms_max field of the ReleaseCeilings read through installation.release_ceilings. send_request names module:installation.resolve_credential with the imported SERVICE_INVOCATION_PURPOSE constant, the pinned service instance and its caller component, closing the open point of 2026-09-21; the pinned httpx dependency is declared in imports.third_party and third_party_by_module.

Both contracts are closed over binding resolution, effect authority, one transport send, durable in-flight/reconciliation writes, value storage and the injected system clock. The outcome-unknown wait reason arrives as an imported data_provider constant.

Content-addressed value bytes below the data root, disclosure-class derivation and retention are closed; derive_output_class takes the maximum in the ascending order of the imported DISCLOSURE_CLASSES constant (A03: open < business_confidential < personal_data) instead of an order the generator would have to guess.

Private per-run spool below the data root, create-exclusive staging, same-filesystem publish and bounded streaming are closed; receive_file applies the port ceiling and the run_spool_file_bytes_max field of the ReleaseCeilings read through installation.release_ceilings, and reads no clock.

Typed NodeExecution/TrialExecution repository operations close trace recording and evidence reads without opaque payload probing. The open disclosure class arrives as an imported data_provider constant.

Typed durable run/effect evidence, deterministic retry policy and exact sandbox/transport calls close execution and restart behavior. The outcome-unknown wait reason arrives as an imported data_provider constant.

All 6 owned contracts are covered by 6 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation; its complete cross-module callable and model dependency surface is declared.

All 1 owned contracts are covered by 1 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation; its complete cross-module callable and model dependency surface is declared.
The fixed FastAPI router, credential extractor and app factory are backend-owned; serve_http retains one closed behavioral contract.
The ordered fail-closed startup note closes store, continuity, owner, manifest, sandbox recovery and gateway composition.

The companion module is fully emitted from persistence_backend/v3, owns only the SQLite schema and typed repository, and imports the four model types required by its generated codecs. The module imports the OperationalUnitOfWork port it implements, as implementation_obligations require and as Cabinet_web's cabinet_persistence does.

Host continuity counter beside the protected configuration, restored-store detection and the owner's confirmation are closed; confirm_continuity bounds the owner statement by the bounded_text_bytes_max field of the ReleaseCeilings read through installation.release_ceilings and the host counter file name is an imported constant.
